title: Viral Deep-Sea Expedition Found a Real-Life Patrick From SpongeBob, And 57 New Species
caption:
During an expedition into Argentina's Mar del Plata Canyon, researchers cataloged dozens of previously undiscovered organisms in just two weeks. Exploring rifts over two miles deep reveals how much marine life remains unrecorded as threats like ocean warming grow.

Source: Sciencealert - Viral Deep-Sea Expedition Found a Real-Life Patrick From SpongeBob, And 57 New Species
